The [[Alderaanian cloak]] was a type of [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] connected to [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] culture. The cloak was worn across the torso, from left shoulder to right hip and down the right [[Limb/Legends|arm]]. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] wore such a cloak.
